name: Leader
overview: You take initiative, direct action, and aren't afraid to stand alone.

traits.Decisive: You make quick choices under pressure.

traits.Initiator: You move forward even when others hesitate.

traits.Commanding: You naturally step into leadership roles.

challenges: May overlook input of othersor move too quickly.
recommendations: Pause to invite feedback from your team.
Reflect on the consequences of impulsive action.
questions: How do you know when to take charge and when to step back?
Who helps you stay grounded when leading?
What do you gain by listening before acting?
